diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting only; branch completeness, finite boundaries and guarded gaps remain separate. Not reader qualification or physical acceptance.
finite_structure_display_gate: Positive R/P >= 90%, exact declared segment count, boundary bijection <= 25 mm, zero guarded gap false length. Frozen before inference; display only, not topology qualification.
sampling: Same sample_segments at voxel_size/2 for both representations. Readers receive only unified normal arrays, voxel size and fixed world origin, never primitive identity or cohort labels.
development_replay: All 80 original NPZ inputs are referenced by their frozen hashes. September mixed 44 and October section 36 are separately summarized scored development replays, not new holdouts. Preparation copies their paired truth into isolated evaluation storage.
new_section_cohort: 40 authored analytic conditions: ten families times two voxel sizes and two axial sampling densities. Fixed seed 431029, phase .23 and new world pose. Variable density full/half/twin shells, 90/270 mm true gaps, 32/68 degree small side branches, exactly paired scatter, rotating sparse arcs and helix. No new reader output or score is seen before freeze.
old_baseline: Preserve and receipt all 320 previous output records. Compare new sampling to unchanged evidence; previous ridges is not rerun.
freeze_policy: Freeze source dependencies, protocol, all unlabelled inputs and separate truth before inference. Verify all 480 ordered normal records before scoring. Do not overwrite failures or adjust methods after seeing this run's scores.
qualification: Three separately reported development/analytic cohorts, not independent physical objects or a G1 pass. Empty positive output is failed recovery; retain all errors, failures and regressions. No alignment to truth.
